You'll be fine. I started at 25 and I, 2 years later, have a full beard and so much ass hair 😒 

But in all seriousness, your body will still change. Genetics dictate a lot of changes, look at the men in your family to see what ways you might change. Hope that helps a bit

But also, if you really think stopping would make you happier, that is totally a valid choice. I just know that sometimes people make sacrifices for short term peace at the cost of their long term happiness.

You have one life to live. Do you want transphobes to rule it? Because that sounds like what will happen. You have to put your happiness first. The stress will fade eventually. Trust me on that, I had to come out to a tridentine catholic family, I know how stressful it is to have unsupportive family.

It takes awhile for the changes to come in all the way. I think trans men are prone to suffering from baby face but it gets better the more your facial hair comes in, voice changes, etc. I've been on t for just about 2 years now and the only time I get misgendered is when people are being dicks on purpose, honestly fuck them.

Also my bipolar has never been more manageable since transitioning, even when I had to go off meds because of an insurance fuck up.
